_comment: Copied to ~/Library/Application Support/disk-health/config.json on first install. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Restart after editing: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.diskhealth.agent
_comment_scan: du-based growth tracking. {brew_prefix} is replaced by /opt/homebrew or /usr/local. Entries deeper than scan_depth or smaller than scan_min_mb are not kept in history. iCloud/CloudStorage are excluded to avoid triggering downloads.
_comment_schedule: Scheduled brew runs only CHECK (update metadata, outdated, doctor, autoremove/cleanup dry-runs). Upgrades only happen when you click 'Run brewed'.
_comment_alerts: Free space thresholds are % of the volume. Growth alerts fire when a folder grows by more than growth_alert_gb_7d GB AND by growth_alert_ratio_7d (25%) in 7 days.
_comment_extra_caches: Your own cache folders. clean: 'contents' empties the folder (the folder itself is kept) or 'cmd' runs the command in 'cmd' (with 'needs': binary name). risk: safe | rebuild | redownload. Only list folders whose contents are safe to lose.
